name: AAC
typeNotes: Proof-native double-entry accounting domain with ledger specs, formal core, circuits, registry, runtime, and governance loop.
authority: Owns AAC ledger/accounting domain semantics, RFC suite, formal ledger statements, accounting registry behavior, circuits, runtime adapters, and product/proof governance loop.
nonGoals: Does not own Atlas site placement, registry schema, or cross-site placement doctrine.
Does not own Premath semantic cover law outside AAC-specific statements that cite upstream law.
Does not own private Personal source data except through explicit redacted exports or admitted accounting projections.
Does not own Bridge secret materialization sessions or credential custody.
Does not own Tusk workflow, issue lanes, or receipt infrastructure.
Does not make unbalanced ledger state valid by product need or proposer claim.
